liebermann.description_de: Die Saint Alban's-Chronik des Roger von Wendover, copirt durch Matheus Paris, Cron. maiora; Matheus' Hist. Angl.
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Roger of Wendover’s St Albans chronicle, as copied by Matthew Paris in the Chronica maiora; and Matthew Paris, Historia Anglorum
liebermann.notes: The St Albans chronicle of Roger of Wendover, copied by Matthew Paris in the Chronica maiora; both contain under 1100 and 1213, and Matthew's Historia Anglorum under 1100, the Coronation Charter of Henry I.

entries.text_de: Die Saint Alban's-Chronik des Roger von Wendover wurde copirt durch Matheus Paris, Cron. maiora5. Beide enthalten je zu a. 1100 und 1213, und Matheus' Hist. Angl.6 enthält zu a. 1100: CHn cor, u. S. 521c.
entries.text_en: The St Albans chronicle of Roger of Wendover was copied by Matthew Paris, Cron. maiora5. Both contain, each under the years 1100 and 1213, and Matthew's Hist. Angl.6 contains under the year 1100: CHn cor, below, p. 521c.

transcription.doubts: Superscript italic 'c' after 'S. 521' is a letter mark, not a footnote number; kept as <sup>c</sup>.
